title: The Slingshot
description: You need to escape the star's gravity, but your fuel budget falls short of escape velocity by itself. A Jupiter-mass planet orbits at 0.5 AU. Fly through its gravity well — a close pass behind it in its orbital direction will fling you outward for free.
hintText: Direct escape costs ~8.25e-8 delta-v — more than your budget. Burn retrograde slightly to lower your periapsis toward the giant planet. A trailing flyby steals orbital energy from the planet and gives it to you.
